{{Quote|The trajectory of that transport may indicate that it came from ''Hoth'', but there's no evidence that ''Wedge Antilles'' is on board.|Barlon Hightower|<ref name="SW78">[[Star Wars (1977) 78|''Star Wars'' (1977) 78]]</ref>}}
'''Barlon Hightower''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]]. A former [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the various guilds in the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]], he eventually opted to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after deciding that staying neutral in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was no longer an option. Assigned to the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter Corps]], he was stationed on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|assault]] on the planet, Hightower was assigned to [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], serving as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] aboard a [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] piloted by [[Stevan Makintay]]. Hightower and Makintay survived the engagement and evacuated Hoth. Relocated to the planet [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]], Hightower took part in search operations to locate [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and personnel lost during the evacuation.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I mean, things got pretty hot on that ice planet when the Empire showed up.|Barlon Hightower|<ref name="SW78" />}}
Barlon Hightower was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CSWE-Hightower" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]]<ref name="EGTW" /> in the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> A [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Hightower worked for the various guilds that operated in the [[Lantillies system/Legends|Lantillies system]] flying [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. Over the course of several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Hightower came to the conclusion that there was no such thing as neutrality in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He decided to join the Rebellion after avoiding arrest.<ref name="EGTW" />

[[File:Rogue_Group_TESB_Manga.jpg|250px|thumb|The twelve airspeeders of Rogue Group, including gunner Hightower, attack during the Battle of Hoth.]]
Serving in the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]], Hightower was assigned to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], as part of the installation's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement. When the base was [[Probe droid/Legends|discovered]] by [[Death Squadron/Legends|Imperial forces]], an evacuation of the facility was ordered. A delaying force of twelve [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] was assembled with [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] drawn from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] as well as [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green]] and [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadrons]]. Hightower was assigned to the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] position of [[Rogue Nine/Legends|Rogue Nine]] and was partnered with pilot [[Stevan Makintay]]. Flying as Rogue [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the snowspeeders managed to delay the [[Blizzard Force/Legends|incoming force]] of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] long enough for the evacuation to be completed. Hightower and Makintay survived the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|battle]] and managed to escape off-world.<ref name="EGTW" />

Hightower was reassigned to [[Haven Base]] on the planet [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]].<ref name="SW78" /> Holding the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], he was assigned to a unit whose primary purpose was to locate [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and personnel separated or lost from the Alliance during the retreat from Hoth.<ref name="CSWE-Hightower" /> [[Standard day/Legends|Days]] after the Battle of Hoth,<ref name="CSWE-Grimraker">{{CSWECite|I|370|Grimraker, Arns}}</ref> he was part of a team&mdash;which included Skywalker and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]&mdash;that intercepted a [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] on a trajectory bearing it away from the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]].<ref name="SW78" /> Aboard were Alliance pilots [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]<ref name="UTI-3">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031218hoth3|series=Hoth: Under the Ice|text=Part 3: Merchants of Death}}</ref> and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], who had been temporarily stranded on Hoth until they had encountered the notorious [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Arns Grimraker]]. In a confrontation, the Alliance pilots had [[Death/Legends|killed]] Grimraker and stolen his ship, the ''[[Death Merchant]]''.<ref name="CSWE-Grimraker" /> Following that assignment, Hightower was posted back to Rogue Squadron.<ref name="CSWE-Hightower" />

==Personality and traits==
Barlon Hightower was a dark-skinned, with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. A skilled pilot<ref name="CSWE-Hightower" /> and gunner,<ref name="EGTW" /> Hightower's skills earned him a posting to Rogue Squadron, the Alliance's foremost starfighter squadron.<ref name="CSWE-Hightower" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barlon Hightower first appeared in the [[Star Wars (1977) 78|seventy-eighth issue]] of [[Marvel Comics|Marvel's]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'' comic]], written by [[David Michelinie]] illustrated by [[Luke McDonnell]],<ref name="SW78" /> and published on [[September 13]], [[1983]].<ref name="ma">''[[Marvel Age]]'' #6</ref> The story, ''Hoth Stuff!'', featured several elements that would be contradicted by later sources, such as a backstory for Wedge Antilles that portrays him as Luke Skywalker's oldest friend from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and a depiction of Wes Janson's death. As a result, the [[canon]]icity of the story was left ambiguous. In addition, the Marvel ''[[Star Wars]]'' stories were deemed to be S-canon (Secondary Canon) by the [[Holocron continuity database]]. According to [[Leland Chee]], [[Lucasfilm]]'s "Keeper of the Holocron," stories categorized as S-canon could be used or ignored by authors as they needed, which left even the existence of Hightower in doubt.<ref name="Chee-Blog">{{Blog|holocron|4|What is the Holocron?}} &ndash; Leland Chee lays out the various canon levels used by Lucasfilm</ref><ref name="Marvel">
{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM|quote=What is the current canon ranking of the Marvel comics? S-canon, with stuff that has been referenced as C-canon.}}</ref>

In [[2003]], [[Wizards of the Coast]] published a series of ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' articles on its [[Wizards.com|website]] called ''[[Hoth: Under the Ice]]''. In the [[Hoth: Under the Ice|third installment]], author [[Cory J. Herndon]] brought elements of ''Hoth Stuff!'' back into continuity by framing the story as a tall tale that Wedge Antilles tells to new recruits, partially to see their faces once they actually meet a very much alive Wes Janson later in their training. Antilles' presence on Hoth after the battle is canonized, as is his confrontation with the scavenger Arns Grimraker.<ref name="UTI-3" /> In [[2008]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' included an entry on Hightower, without mentioning the specifics of the story he appeared in, canonizing his existence within the ''Star Wars'' [[The galaxy/Legends|universe]].<ref name="CSWE-Hightower" /> A separate entry for Arns Grimraker confirmed the scavenger's presence on Hoth in the aftermath of the battle, but cut his arrival down to days after the conflict, not [[Standard month/Legends|months]],<ref name="CSWE-Grimraker" /> as stated in ''Hoth Stuff!''.<ref name="UTI-3" /> The entry also canonized Janson's presence during these events.<ref name="CSWE-Grimraker" />

In [[2012]], authors [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] included Hightower as a member of Rogue Squadron during the Battle of Hoth in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="EGTW" /> This article assumes that the basic events of ''Hoth Stuff!''&mdash;that Hightower was a member of a team that recovered a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] containing Antilles, who had escaped from Hoth&mdash;occurred, but the specifics of Antilles' story, now framed as [[in-universe]], did not.
